programme.title: The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: In this sequel to THE BULLET VANISHES, Sean Lau plays an inspector who is lead down a rabbit hole of discovery as he investigates a prison escape.

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Based on Hong Kong's biggest financial scandal of Ching Yat Yin, who rises from rags to become a billionaire. An ICAC investigator spends 15 years to uncover the truth behind his rapid rise in wealth.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer becomes entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives. When the girl he likes dies mysteriously, he uncovers the secret of a 'ghost marriage'.

programme.title: Hong Kong Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee, a production head of an advertising firm, runs into her ex-boyfriend before a commercial shoot & drowns her sorrows drinking at Lan Kwai Fong. She picks herself up with Chan's help.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman takes charge of an operation to arrest the criminals who perform a heist on the train, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead...

programme.title: The Way We Talk
programme.desc: Three deaf youths—Wolf, Sophie and Alan—develop a profound bond and support each other through sign language. United by love and friendship, they embark on a journey of self-discovery and resilience.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Right-hand man to a Macau tycoon, Zun Fei, is torn between love and justice amid brutal underworld violence and power struggles. When a deadly gamble turns against him, his life hangs in the balance.

programme.title: I Want to Be Rich
programme.desc: Born into poverty, Wah goes astray but has a kind heart. After meeting and falling in love with a Vietnamese woman Mei, he decides to rebuild his life and finally achieves his dream of wealth.

programme.title: Victim(s)
programme.desc: After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur student murders his classmate, the victim's mother and the killer's mother uncover hidden truths about their sons and face very different paths of grief and torment.

programme.title: Hit N Fun
programme.desc: Ad executive Lin uncovers her boyfriend's affair with a champion boxer and challenges her to a match. Under the former boxing legend's training, her quest for revenge evolves into self-discovery.

programme.title: Trending Topic
programme.desc: Chen Miao's viral article leads to a girl's suicide, prompting her to dig deeper into it and uncovers hidden truths. She joins the battle to advocate for the weak as public opinion shifts.

programme.title: I Did it My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive dark world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and secret operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: Liao Jie and his father save to buy a home but are too poor. Liao Jie learns survival skills from their landlord Old Fox and ends up hurting him, but his empathy stops him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Ah Long lives in hardship with his daughter. When she is abducted in Thailand, Long's faith shatters, and he risks everything to track down the trafficking ring, transforming into a vengeful killer.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing, who can see ghosts since young, discovers that the visions that once haunted him have become worse in his home. Caught between the living and dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.title: Dust to Dust
programme.desc: A blurred figure in a news clip prompts retired cop Wang Shou Yue to reinvestigate a cold case where the mastermind gets tipped off and escapes. A battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Keep Rolling
programme.desc: Man Lim Chung's directorial debut is a work of love which traces the life, four-decade career & filmmaking philosophy of Ann Hui, one of Hong Kong's greatest filmmakers.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy when he is sent to prison for embezzlement. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Far Far Away
programme.desc: A computer geek who has only been in love once suddenly & surprisingly finds himself getting romantically involved with five different women. Will he find "the-one"?

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: A pregnant painter hires a confinement nanny, but inexplicable incidents start happening in the house as her one-month confinement begins, threatening her and her baby daughter...

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on a string of real robberies and murder cases, a detective engages in a mouse-and-cat game with the 'Eagle Gang', a group of sophisticated, well-trained and ruthless robbers.

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: After accidentally killing veteran detective Zhan's wife, Wang Tao seeks redemption by assisting Zhan in tracking a serial killer. However, her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: Measure In Love
programme.desc: A massive quake splits the world into two zones with different time speeds. Medical student An Qing meets a boy named Shu Zai, yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged.

programme.title: Silent Code
programme.desc: Reporter Lan research news from across a popular BBS forum. Xiang, a forum founder, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas but being the subject of heated debate due to a leaked video.

programme.title: Back To The Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself.

programme.title: Possession Street
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of a deserted mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must battle the zombies as the mall descends into hell.

programme.title: Cold War 2
programme.desc: Sean Lau, appointed as the Commissioner of Police after the success of the Cold War rescue operation, finds his reign rocked by the abduction of this wife and daughter.

programme.title: Septet : The Story of Hong Kong
programme.desc: Starring Sammo Hung, Ann Hui, Patrick Tam, Yuen Wo Ping, Johnnie To & more, Hong Kong's seven most revered directors compose an anthology of stories for their beloved city.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: The first Bollywood movie made in Hong Kong, it is about an interracial love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy! Faced with many difficulties, can their love prevail?

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: A baby hatch that never closes faces moral backlash. Nevertheless, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie, and Nuru remain committed to helping desperate mothers and abandoned newborns.

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: Five bounty hunters are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings plaguing a hotel group in Bangkok. Can they solve the crime and finally collect the bounty?

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures
programme.desc: Before graduation, five high school friends decide to do something unforgettable and take on a seemingly impossible challenge - winning a crucial basketball game that could change their lives.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr. Lo's sons prank Kung on his birthday with a fake lottery win, sparking chaos that unexpectedly heals old wounds and brings the quirky family closer together.

programme.title: Possession Street
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of a deserted mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must battle the zombies as the mall descends into hell.

programme.title: Love Is The Only Answer
programme.desc: When a flash of her groom's infidelity is revealed at their wedding, Bo cancels the entire affair. However, within a year, he comes knocking on her door again.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Hong Kong
programme.desc: Helmed by four Best Actors and set in Hong Kong in the 1970s, this exciting action film charts how the ICAC dealt with corruption within the police force in its early stages of establishment.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Ah Mei, bound by cerebral palsy and her mother's push for a forced hysterectomy, finds love with Ken through a disability intimacy service. Together, they forge a tender bond that defies all barriers.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Body and Soul
programme.desc: This horror anthology series returns featuring three spooky crime stories about an ex-hair model, a cat lover and the love triangle between a dental nurse, a dentist, and a chef.

programme.title: Dust to Dust
programme.desc: A blurred figure in a news clip prompts retired cop Wang Shou Yue to reinvestigate a cold case where the mastermind gets tipped off and escapes. A battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Ready o/r Rot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi face pre-marital strife. Meanwhile, Grey Bear doubts his wife's fidelity and Ken faces a life crisis following his girlfriend's pregnancy. Can they resolve their relationship issues?

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era, revolving around a pregnant woman, a bullied boy who committed suicide, and some company staff who open a box of used clothes.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress.

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: In this Golden Horse winner starring Gordon Lam, a retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian drug mule.

programme.title: I Believe
programme.desc: Chu Chu waits 10 years for her first love, who marries another. Losing faith, she meets a wedding planner and a wealthy man, both offering solace. Torn between them, who will she choose in the end?

programme.title: One Second
programme.desc: In Zhang Yimou's screen gem that captures the power of cinema, a labour camp escapee seeks a newsreel that captures a one-second glimpse of his daughter. However, he has competition.

programme.title: Burning Blood

programme.title: Burning Stars

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: A team of investigators was sent to an old building believed to be haunted by evil spirits, only to discover an unexpected secret concerning the future of the structure.

programme.title: Soul Mate
programme.desc: July and An Sheng's strong friendship is put to the test when they encounter a guy, Su Jia Ming, sparking a love triangle that alters both their destinies.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later, they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan seeks help from psychiatrist Dr Jim. As she heals, Jim is haunted by the same disturbances when his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: The Monkey King 3
programme.desc: The Queen of Female Kingdom falls in love with Monk Tang, but her advisor orders Monk Tang and his disciples to be killed. As the River Spirit appears, the kingdom is plunged into crisis!

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: To achieve his goal, a man who craves supreme power stops at nothing, including murdering the Emperor and using his own daughter as a pawn.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Starring the incomparable Ti Lung and Alexander Fu, this saga captures how a swordsman and a thief joins forces to defeat an assassin sent by the evil Kuo.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chin Han return with a Huangmei Opera classic, depicting a loving couple whose marriage is being poisoned by the husband's stepmother.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A jewel thief tries to have a new life as a singer but a series of robberies gets people wondering if he has returned to his old ways.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: A woman gets involved in a Ching Dynasty salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and dilemmas gone rotten.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Ling Yun of 'Hellgate' plays a magician-warrior who unwittingly protects a villain from an ambush, until his wife and friend's deaths open his eyes.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: This epic depicts the romance between the Jade Emperor's seventh daughter and a young village man. When Heaven and Earth meet, can a common ground be found?

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei, swordswoman extraordinaire, teams with Lo Lieh in this fast-paced 'Martial Arts World' adventure, a quest for the legendary 'Jade Dragon Sword.'

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: What starts off as a musical romp turns into something more akin to a Shakespearean tragedy than a beach-babe party. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Flying Dagger is an exceptional collaboration between Chang Cheh and swordswoman supreme, Cheng Pei-pei of 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon.'

programme.title: Whose Baby Is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Inoue Umetsugu's last Shaw film before his untimely death is a testament to the auteur's carefree comic talent.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: A village boy recruits his friends to help peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Facets of Love
programme.desc: In this king of epic dramas, three sexy vignettes are set against a Ming Dynasty brothel that steams with erotic myths, secret trysts and pleasurable twists.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: According to this sex comedy, the true power behind China's many warlords were the prostitutes that these men would visit.

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are saved by Master Lian during a botched exorcism and they beseech him to teach them. Then his friend is killed and with his master's help, Lu avenges him.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: A clash of cultures and such ensue after Mr. Funny Bone and Big Potato open an old-fashioned healing clinic in ultra-modern Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: Starring John Chiang, Ti Lung, Yueh Wah, Ku Feng and Chen Kuan Tai, this classic depicts how the brothers of the classic Water Margin fight local authorities.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: This compelling Shaw Brothers Huangmei Opera depicts the romance of star-crossed lovers the son of a respected government official and a famed prostitute.

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: When a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom, a persecuted waiter turns to a famed 'drunken master' for help.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: This seminal film adaptation of a 17th century Pu Songling work is the precursor of the famed 'A Chinese Ghost Story'.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho stars in this movie as a revenge seeking gun-for-hire who always gets her man in more ways than one!

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: This moving tale centers on a childless woman who cares for an emotionally battered girl.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: A Shaolin hero and the vicious Pai Mei lock horns in this kungfu revenge tale that spans two generations.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang brings us this delightful adventure, which revolves around Emperor Chien Lung's incognito journey through China.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: A righteous man who can't fight and an unjustly wronged swordsman team up to battle against evil.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: Two students fall in love but their two families are enemies and separated by a river that is filled with crocodiles and beasts.

programme.title: Portrait in Crystal
programme.desc: Action - Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader 'Yama' to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan and Pai Pan to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: This three-film anthology collectively offers up a captivating examination of human obsession and love.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: Bandits disturb the peace until a martial artist and his student, son and servant go to avenge his murdered wife and set things right.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A martial artist joins the police force in order to pursue the man who killed his best friend but it is only years later that he discovers a startling clue.

programme.title: Let's Fall in Love
programme.desc: Pressured by his parents to marry prior to taking over his father's business, Guan rejects every girl they find but then, he stumbles upon the perfect one?

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Adapted from a book by Ku Lung, this spectacular martial arts showcase features an all-star cast including Ti Lung, Lo Mang, Ai Fei and Lily Li.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: In this twisted comedy, a gambling game between a rookie con artist and an experienced flimflam man has life or death repercussions.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: When an argument gets out of hand between a regular Joe and a wealthy businessman, regular Joe finds himself thrust into the middle of a high stakes wager!

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu gets out of jail, he gets involved again with his crooked Uncle Chou and caught in other rackets and silly situations.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: A hot-headed patriot gets entwined in the collapse of the Qing Dynasty and the rise of the new Chinese republic.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: 3 beautiful salesgirls masquerade as high society belles in a bid to realize their dreams of marrying millionaires.

programme.title: The Kid With the Golden Arm
programme.desc: Director Chang Cheh reunites the Five Venoms in his second biggest cult hit in the West, featuring Lo Meng's most memorable performance.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Based on a famed Chinese opera, this melodramatic film depicts the romance between Zhang Sheng, an impoverished scholar, and Ying Ying, who is from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Based on Gu Long's novel, this drama depicts how the martial artist Shen Lang, unites with his comrades to take down the notorious thug Huan His Wang.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang directs this fascinating comedy about three couples and forbidden love across Macau and Hong Kong.

programme.title: Wits of the Brats
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng both co-stars and co-directs his brother Chang Chan-peng in this all-out action comedy featuring the best in the business.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: A young woman's life turns tragic after she discovers that she's adopted and then goes in search of her real mother.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: A young couple's love is put to the test over a tumultuous period of Chinese history. Starring Linda Lin Dai, Kwan Shan.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: In this classic, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu take on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh, making this a 4-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel Water Margin and starring Ti Lung, this award-winning drama depicts how the courageous Wu Song defeats a tiger, and his bond with Wu Da Lang.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: This is a thrilling mix of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, vengeance and edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Ding, a con woman swindles a diamond ring off a rich man, but when it ends up in another man's hands, she now has to get it back.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Kung-fu takes on a macabre, horrific flair in this stunning story of swordsmen and women struggling to save their true loves and their sanity.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: This drama centres on the seductive Judy. A woman with a rich husband, she also has two lovers who happen to be brothers!

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: See how Prince 4 tries his hardest to kill the heir apparent, Prince 14 and how, out of frustration, he finally engages an assassin to do the job.

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1977)
programme.desc: The Mad Monk rushes around saving hawkers from crumbling walls and bullies, recovering stolen money and punishing a ruthless court official and his son.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: When masked killers begin wreaking havoc, three fearless fighters investigate the truth in this magnificent martial arts saga.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: In this retelling of China's most popular romance, superstar Ivy Ling Po plays a scholar who tries to seduce a servant.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: The story of the Shaolin Temple's betrayal by the White-Browed Hermit and Shaolin hothead Fong Sai-yuk's revenge bid gets retold again.

programme.title: The Naval Commandos
programme.desc: Tony Liu, Ti Lung, Fu Sheng, David Chiang and Shih Szu star in this rousing epic of a near suicidal mission to destroy the Japanese Navy's flagship in 1937.

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: The peace-loving prince of the Dali nation turns out to be the target for vengeance because of an old romantic feud.

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: In this wuxia work, not everyone is happy when a student of the Grand Master falls for the Poison's Master daughter.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Lisa Lu stars as the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty in this film that is full of palace intrigues and power games.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After they reunite in a casino, two lovers (Lily Ho and Yueh Hua) vow to rid the place of corrupt military leaders and criminal others.

programme.title: Mr Funny Bone
programme.desc: Whenever Mr. Funny Bone travels about with his sidekick Big Potato, he often gets involved in all manner of charming comic mishaps.

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: See how seven men stationed at Pa Tou Lou Tzu, a key point of the Great Wall, took on an entire Japanese army for five days before they succumbed.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: Three women and three men beguile, blackmail, bicker and backstab each other all the way to a shocking surprise ending.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: Screen legend Alexander Fu plays a son who constantly challenges his father's patience and kung-fu skills until they are forced to fight together.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: This fascinating, humorous box office smash captures a cross-section of Hong Kong society and their issues -- all crammed into a single tenement building.

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Essie Lin Chia plays an evil lady warrior who raises the son of a swordsman who scorned her with a blood-curdling ulterior motive in mind.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Pat Ting Hung, Carrie Ku Mei and Li Hsiang Chun star in this delightful tale of mistaken identities caused by monogrammed handkerchiefs.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: A sword-master turned umbrella-maker goes up against a zombie-maker with a 'finger of doom' in this critically acclaimed film.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: In this award-winning classic, a beauty disguises herself as a boy to attend school yet tend to her lover. Stars Lo Ti, Ling Po.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: Wong Fei Hung (Gordon Liu) fights for balance in the martial world with the evil Lu school and a northern master in their employ.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager's use of the Boxers to remove the foreign powers from China yields unexpected results. Starring Alexander Fu.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: A secret service agent, Chao Pu Fun, must protect the innocent against a power-mad Eunuch.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: Three sisters (the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei) attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness.

programme.title: The Tigress of Shaolin
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung co-stars with Liu Chia-yung in this fast-paced comedy that features the outrageous Leprosy Boxing style.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: After a man's household pays dearly for his faith in his business rival, he turns to his swordmate and that man's son for help.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: In this fascinating saga about a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang, Danny Lee plays a misunderstood refugee, while Ray Lui is a cop battling his own conscience.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: An extraordinary youth is determined to reunite with his goddess mother and unravel the mythical Lotus Lamp. Starring Linda Lin Dai.

programme.title: Oath of Death
programme.desc: When Sung Dynasty patriot Chin Liang runs afoul of a corrupt acquaintance, he is forced to avenge the villain's treachery via a self-sacrificing oath.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: An emperor's obsession with his consort distracts him, allowing his cruel prime minister who also happens to be his consort's brother, to run the nation.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: A man lies, cheats and steals his way into operating a casino but when he incurs the wrath of a Japanese gang leader.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Directed by Chang Cheh and starring Ti Lung in his first main role, this drama depicts how two lovers contend with family opposition and an unjust accusation.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: In director Kuei Chih Hung and kung-fu champion Chen Kuan Tai's best martial arts movie, Chen illuminates the screen as an obsessive chief constable.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Ti Lung plays a helpless man who is under the spell of an evil witch doctor in this bone-chilling tale of good versus evil.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: A Shaolin hero and the vicious Pai Mei lock horns in this kungfu revenge tale that spans two generations.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: A village boy recruits his friends to help peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister

programme.title: Shadow Girl

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
